name: chorus
description: A local-first workspace for collaborating with multiple coding agents in one shared conversation.

scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run test
scripts.e2e: pnpm --filter @chorus/desktop run build && pnpm --filter @chorus/desktop run e2e
scripts.package: pnpm --filter chorus-vscode run build && pnpm --filter chorus-vscode run package && pnpm --filter @chorus/desktop run package
